# Compact Morkahja legacy data fixtures

These are **small snapshots of real public game content**, copied from
`babunidev/Morkahja` at commit `239cf21ed759cf12137e68ae41a85a0a26382fb9`,
from `client/public/game/`. They preserve actual key spellings, field shapes
and structural metadata, including historical misspellings.

Each file contains only the first two representative records (or first
populated avatar/frame) rather than the full game content. They are used only
in disposable temporary test directories. No production files are modified.

Source repository: https://github.com/babunidev/Morkahja

Scope limitation: representative schema verification is not exhaustive
validation of the full source dataset or all image encoding variations.
